assets.name: Weathered Rod
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: fantasy RPG fishing gear item icon
Style/medium: Modia fantasy ink-and-wash watercolor item illustration, bold dark hand-inked outline, controlled watercolor shading, subtle aged-parchment character only inside the painted subject; polished readable game icon, strictly 2D.
Composition/framing: one isolated item centered diagonally from lower-left to upper-right, full object visible, crisp strong silhouette, generous empty padding on all sides, no frame.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, or lighting variation.
Constraints: simple opaque subject, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, no glow extending into the background, no text, letters, numbers, UI, border, logo, or watermark. Do not use #00ff00 anywhere in the subject.
Primary request: Weathered Rod icon.
Subject: a humble old fishing rod made from crooked sun-bleached brown wood, wrapped tan twine grip, worn dark iron ferrules, tiny plain reel; sturdy and visibly patched. Show the rod itself as a compact solid item with no loose fishing line, no hook, and no bait.
